name: Craftville - Bigger / Wider Tab List
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: qbos
description: Craftville - Bigger / Wider Tab List increases the maximum number of visible players in the tab list from 80 to 180. It is a fully client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 or newer and does not require Fabric API.
needs: Mixin: 1 point inside the game's methods
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Mixin (0.5)
